title: Reference Link
summary: Navigation surface that pairs a real destination with a compact reference.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

appearance.description: card is the reference as its own box: frame, fill and padding, the name on up to two lines, underlined under the pointer and on focus. inline is a link in running text (C147): it flows and wraps with the sentence, takes the size of the text around it and is always underlined; the type icon (icon, none by default) and the record's number (text) in a quiet ink go with the name. plain is the link alone on a line, taking the width of its text, for a reference inside something that is already a box -- a record’s field, a table cell -- underlined under the pointer; with line or size it keeps one line and ends in an ellipsis.

copy.description: A card only: a «Копировать ссылку» / Copy link icon button at its end copies the full address (the clipboard component's data-sf-copy route, decision C48). Off by default.

disabled.description: Render an unavailable, non-focusable reference without navigation.

href.description: Real navigation destination. Required for an enabled reference.

icon.description: The type icon before the name. Absent: the arrow in a card, a size or on a line, none in text (inline); empty: no icon at all

line.description: Takes the text line of this form size as a link without the card, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height.

size.description: Form size: the reference becomes a control of that size, for a row of fields or a table cell. Empty keeps the card spacing.

state.description: The target is gone: missing (deleted) or forbidden (no access). No link then: the words dimmed, the broken-link icon, the reason in words after the name («удалена», «нет доступа», in the page's language); href is not followed. Empty: a live reference.

target.description: Native browsing-context target. _blank adds the open_in_new sign after the words and «(откроется в новой вкладке)» / "(opens in a new tab)" to the accessible name, in the page's language.

text.description: Compact route, source or number shown beside the label: at the far end of a card or a line, after the name in a quiet ink in text (a record's number).

aria-label.description: Accessible name of the link in place of its visible label, for a label that needs more words out of context. Empty: the label names it.

navigation.enabled: native anchor with a real href
navigation.boundary: the complete reference surface is the pointer and keyboard-focus boundary
navigation.gone: state missing or forbidden: no link, the reason in words

onClick.summary: Adds a click listener on the host.

accessibility.focus: Keep visible focus on the active control.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-reference-link when a real destination benefits from a visible route, source or other compact reference.
do_not: Do not use Reference Link for a generic action or a plain text link
Do not render an enabled reference without href
Do not leave href on a disabled reference
Do not write the new-tab words or sign by hand: target _blank adds both
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
